source: Student Notes, Energy Audit (2020), Green Audit (2023), OpenStreetMap Geocoding
methodology_note: CRITICAL: VIT has primary HT metering at the 33/11 kV substation and sub-meters at 12 powerhouses. No per-room building IoT sensor network exists. All building-level electrical loads and CO2 footprints are transparent modelled estimates derived from connected transformer rating, floor area, lab equipment density, and student occupancy. Displayed with dashed borders and labelled as 'Modelled Estimate'.

hotspots.name: SMEC (School of Mechanical Engineering)
hotspots.category: High Electrical Load & Direct CO2 Emitter
hotspots.model_method: Equipment inventory: Thermal Engineering, Heat Transfer rigs, and IC Engine dynamometers.
hotspots.notes: Direct combustion in IC Engine test rigs + heavy HVAC requirement for workshop bays.

hotspots.name: SELECT (School of Electrical Engineering)
hotspots.model_method: Heavy machinery labs, synchronous dynamometers, industrial drives, and power electronics test benches.
hotspots.notes: Primary high-voltage testing infrastructure and motor drive labs.

hotspots.name: Centre for Functional Materials (CFM)
hotspots.model_method: 24/7 high-temperature sintering furnaces, thin-film sputtering, and cleanroom HVAC.
hotspots.notes: Continuous thermal conditioning required for vacuum and coating systems.

hotspots.name: Centre for Bio-separation Technology (CBST)
hotspots.model_method: Bank of -80°C deep freezers, preparative HPLC columns, high-speed refrigerated centrifuges.

hotspots.name: SCHEME (SMV - Chemical & Process Engineering)
hotspots.model_method: Bench-scale distillation, gas absorption columns, chemical synthesis reactors.
hotspots.notes: Process emissions from solvent recovery and reaction setups.

hotspots.name: Technology Tower (TT)
hotspots.model_method: Dedicated Tech Tower Powerhouse (2x 800 kVA transformers) serving simulation software clusters and CTS.
hotspots.notes: Houses computer graphics labs, software labs, and central campus routing switchgear.

hotspots.name: Pearl Research Park (PRP)
hotspots.category: High Electrical Load & Central Chiller Node
hotspots.model_method: Dedicated PRP Power House (1x 2000 kVA transformer, 1x 810 kVA generator).
hotspots.notes: Convergent research building with central atrium, IT suites, and heavy simulation labs.

hotspots.name: Silver Jubilee Tower (SJT)
hotspots.model_method: Classroom blocks, smart galleries, rooftop solar PV array (part of 2.113 MWp installation).
hotspots.notes: Major student daytime gathering point with extensive rooftop solar array.

hotspots.name: Mahatma Gandhi Block
hotspots.model_method: Radiant cooling + indirect evaporative cooling (50% energy reduction vs conventional split ACs: 48.79 kWh/m2/yr).
hotspots.notes: National green benchmark implementing India Cooling Action Plan (ICAP) principles.

hotspots.name: Men's Hostel District Chiller Plant
hotspots.model_method: 2x 2000 kVA dedicated transformers; 4,500 TR running capacity serving Q, M, N, K, L blocks.
hotspots.notes: Uses recycled water from campus STPs for cooling tower evaporative makeup.

hotspots.name: Men's Hostels (Blocks A through J)
hotspots.model_method: Hostel Power House-1 (630 + 800 + 2x1000 kVA); historical site of 2018 rolling load shedding.
hotspots.notes: Subject to 1-hour staggered load rotation during 2018-19 grid deficits.

hotspots.name: Men's Hostels (Blocks K through R)
hotspots.model_method: Hostel Power House 2 & 3 (4x 1000 kVA); 10+ storey modern towers connected to DCS.
hotspots.notes: Connected to district cooling and solar hot water heat pump infrastructure.

hotspots.name: Ladies' Hostels Cluster
hotspots.model_method: LH Chiller Plant (2x 2000 kVA) + dedicated 47,000 LPD solar water heating arrays.
hotspots.notes: 11 blocks catering to 8,000+ female students with extensive rooftop solar water systems.

hotspots.name: 33/11 kV Primary Main Substation
hotspots.model_method: Metered utility incoming from TANGEDCO/TNPDCL grid (HT Tariff 1A).
hotspots.notes: Point of common coupling with 2x 5 MVA main step-down transformers.

hotspots.name: Central STP & VIT Lake Ecosystem
hotspots.model_method: 3 MLD sewage treatment plant + 300 m3 biomethanation plant + PWD stormwater percolation lake.
hotspots.notes: Recycles 4.54 MLD water; biocomposter generates fuel for 90 kVA total gas generator capacity.
